purpose: Named route guidance and separately verified date-scoped operator observations. A published trail description is NOT a live access report.

policy.text: The maintained winter walking route leads to Upper Falls. The longer summer waterfall circuits are not maintained winter walking routes.
The official 2.65-mile snowshoe loop begins beyond the ski trail parking area at East City Limits Road. The adjacent groomed cross-country ski tracks are off-limits to snowshoes.

The Lakeshore Trail runs above the sandstone cliffs from Meyers Beach. Winter footing may be snow-packed or icy; lake-ice travel to the caves is a separate activity. Park-wide severe-cold closures can include Meyers Beach.
